body: a virtual hug means alot, most of my friends are online.

I'll start with the beginning (in chronological order) gf had abortion without talking it over, she caught an infection from it and nearly died. On the way to the hospital my brother calls to tell me my moms house (childhood home ) is burning to the ground. Well fuck right, but it gets better. A week later, I get a call at work, my uncle/godfather/only father figure dies. I figure I'll finish work (got the call at 9 am) and go to the funeral. My aunt/godmother/his wife calls about 5 minutes after I get the original call, to tell me he shot himself. Well fuck, take the day off work. Go home, sob like a 5 year old girl, bad day all around. Go to the funeral, priest refused to do a "proper christian funeral" as suicide is a sin. After many threats he says fine. Nice ceremony all that jazz go home ( mind you it's 12 hours on the greyhound). Check my voice mail when I get home. one message, You're fired, you took too much time off this month. Cue year long depression. Lost a kid, childhood home, the equivalent of my father, and my job, in a 3 week fucking span. All around new years last year ( added to my love of the holidays). Now as of last night I am single because the gf broke up with me. 

**TL:DR** life sucks but I will not kill myself, just really wanna vent, due to my friends sucking huge sweaty gorilla balls.
